verdict.rationale: Zero documents its own programmatic interface, the ZeroMCP server. It exposes operations to list, get, send, draft and delete emails, manage labels, and mark messages read or unread. Authentication requires copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, and OAuth is only 'coming soon'. There is no general REST API reference, so this is a documented agent interface rather than a full public API. Missing for 10: a stable public API with proper API-key or OAuth auth, endpoint/schema reference docs, rate-limit or versioning details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails
Get all user labels - Create new custom labels with custom colors - Delete existing labels
You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
